column1: # COPYING.picolibc (picolibc 1.8.12) licence labels met by the libc.a members the userland ports link,
# mapped by hand to SPDX licences (2026-10-29 licence-gate lane). TEXT_SHA256 is over the label's text
# with whitespace collapsed; scripts/picolibc-provenance.py refuses a text that differs. A LicenseRef
# is a permissive-looking text with no SPDX id: it is not on the licence policy's allowed list until
# the owner accepts it. Host-path rows name each clang resource header by exact path, with the file's
# sha256 in column 2: the only files outside the tarball the build may read (scripts/build-picolibc.sh
# and scripts/picolibc-provenance.py refuse any other, and any other content).
